result.query: SELECT json_build_object('active_vip_intents',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_vip_intents WHERE released_at IS NULL),'historical_vip_intents',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_vip_intents WHERE released_at IS NOT NULL),'active_subnet_refs',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_subnet_refs WHERE released_at IS NULL),'historical_subnet_refs',(SELECT count(*) FROM network_lb_subnet_refs WHERE released_at IS NOT NULL),'remaining_platform',(SELECT json_agg(json_build_object('id',resource_id,'kind',kind,'state',state,'reason',reason)) FROM network_platform_resources WHERE state<>'deleted'));
